description: Serialized settings schemas (the namespaces of a real settings.describe answer plus hand-built schemas covering every schemastery resolver) against many values. `expect` is null when dsh's own SettingsSchemaService accepts the value, else its failure text; `messageExact: false` compares the verdict only (the text depends on the JavaScript engine). Inputs: tool/vectors/synth_settings_trace.py.

expectedBy.model: dsh TypeScript settings schema service over the vendored schemastery resolver
realClasses: Schema.resolve and every resolver (vendor/schemastery/src/index.ts), cosmokit deepEqual/clone/volatile
glue: case driver: structuredClone per case, a throwing rehydrate counts as a failure
